page.overview:
Who is Archie?

Archie was a character in Archie Comics.

He is among the characters of the series who threw Homer Simpson out of their car when Moose told him to stay out of Riverdale. Later, Homer read the comic series and complained about the "stuck-up Riverdale punks".

When Jughead, Moose, Reggie, Betty Cooper, and Veronica Lodge pranked Bart Simpson with a quarter glued to the sidewalk, Jughead lamented that Archie was no longer alive to see it.

Milhouse Van Houten portrayed Archie in a school play dramatization of The CW TV series Riverdale alongside Ralph Wiggum as Jughead and Sherri and Terri as the mothers of Moose's babies.
